items.title: William "Ba Ba" Ridgley Interview, 1961-04-11
items.q: We didn't have no other fella but John Porter.

ctx.x: He went to St. Louis. He's from St. Louis it says here, the saxophone player. And a guy called Jesse on tuba. I don't know who Jesse is. Big dog dog fella it looks like.
That's John Porter. Might be. That's where it is. We didn't have no other fella but John Porter.
It's an upright tuba. Yeah. John Porter. Let's see.

items.title: William "Ba Ba" Ridgley Interview, 1959-06-02
items.q: He was playing another for him at that time. John Porter playing bass violin.

ctx.x: He was playing another for him at that time. John Porter playing bass violin. John Porter played... Bass tubo, you know.
He played tubo, I didn't know he was in front of me.
